summary: Converts SOP point attributes into CHOP channels for positions, colors, normals, texture coordinates, point indexes, custom attributes, and normalized positions.
key_concepts: SOP to CHOP creates CHOP channels from point attributes on a selected SOP.
Position output reads the P attribute and creates tx, ty, and tz channels.
Color, normal, texture coordinate, point index, normalized position, and custom attribute toggles select which SOP point data becomes CHOP samples.
Group restricts conversion to points in a named SOP point group.
Custom attributes are selected with Attribute Scope and can be renamed with Rename Scope.
The official docs note SOP to CHOP works in tandem with Channel SOP for editing point data in CHOPs and feeding it back to geometry.

key_params.name: autoexportroot
key_params.note: Root path for automatic channel-name exports

key_params.name: exporttable
key_params.note: DAT table used by DAT table export methods

common_gotchas: SOP to CHOP works on point attributes; vertex or primitive attributes may need conversion first.
Custom attribute scopes must match SOP attribute names exactly or with supported patterns.
Transformed output depends on the transform object, so keep object-space versus world-space use explicit.
Color Alpha uses the alpha color attribute and creates the alpha channel; do not assume RGB includes alpha.
Rename Scope must provide one name per acquired attribute value when overriding channel names.
For the opposite direction, use Channel SOP rather than SOP to CHOP.
